scope: Selected research results and open questions; new topics may be added with stable IDs and repository-relative paths. This is not a catalog of every algorithm problem.
version_policy: The top-level publication_commit identifies the original orthogonal research snapshot. Later results carry their own publication_commit when pinned; cite each result's immutable proof link. Entry pages and this index are maintained on the default branch.

notation.N: Number of road vertices, at most n^2
notation.W: Total individual candidate checks at newly discovered relative displacements

status_definitions.current_proof: A general written proof is supplied in this repository; this is a repository classification, not a claim of external peer review or formal proof-assistant verification.
status_definitions.refuted_conjecture: A previously proposed claim has a documented counterexample; use the counterexample, not the claim, as the result.
status_definitions.historical_upper_bound: A valid earlier bound superseded in strength by a current proof.
status_definitions.historical_experiment: Finite evidence retained for reproducibility; it does not prove the associated general conjecture.
status_definitions.conjecture: A precise claim awaiting proof or refutation.
status_definitions.experimental_evidence: A claim supported by finite experiments, without a general proof.
status_definitions.open_question: A research question without an established answer.

summary.zh: 对只在新位移处筛选的候选列表算法，完整历史的收费证明去掉了对数因子，得到一般森林上的 O(n³+m) 上界。
summary.en: Complete-history charging removes the logarithmic factor for candidate-list filtering at new displacements, giving O(n³+m) time on general forests.

title.zh: 四邻接网格森林平移匹配的三次方复杂度上界
title.en: A cubic time bound for translation matching in four-neighbor grid forests

assumptions: Road cells induce a forest with all orthogonal neighbor edges retained on an n-by-n board; the road set may be empty.
The entire movement prefix must remain on roads under translation, without rotation or reflection.
Candidates are eliminated permanently on failure; the candidate-list algorithm scans only at first visits to relative displacements.
conclusions: Time O(n^2 + m + nN), hence O(n^3 + m); space O(n^2).
When m >= n-1, this candidate-list algorithm has matching worst-case time Theta(n^3 + m).
For short walks, time O(n^2 + m + N min(m,n)).
limitations: The lower bound concerns this candidate-list algorithm, not every possible algorithm for the problem.
Finite checks supplement the written proof; they do not exhaust all boards or movement sequences.

summary.zh: 保持原位置与全部四邻接边时，补点不一定能把森林连成树；这种障碍可以扩展到线性数量、每棵线性大小的路径。
summary.en: With positions and all induced edges preserved, adding vertices need not connect a forest into a tree—even for linearly many paths of linear size.

title.zh: 诱导四邻接网格森林不一定能通过补点扩充成树
title.en: Induced four-neighbor grid forests need not extend to trees by adding vertices

assumptions: Original integer-grid vertex positions are fixed and every original vertex is retained.
All edges between vertices at Manhattan distance one are induced and cannot be selectively removed.
Only vertices may be added; even arbitrary enlargement of the board is allowed.
conclusions: There exists a finite F whose induced grid graph is a forest but no finite superset S has an induced grid graph that is a tree.
A 5-by-5 example consists of a 13-vertex path and a singleton.
Two obstructed components may both be paths with Theta(n) vertices.
An n-by-n board may contain Theta(n) components, each of size Theta(n), such that any selected pair cannot be extended to an induced tree even after removing all other components.
For integer s >= 1 and n = 12s+1, the nested construction has s+1 trees, each with between 2n-5 and 4n-7 vertices.
limitations: This refutes the fixed-position induced vertex-addition reduction; it does not rule out other reductions allowing relocation, scaling, edge deletion, or separate component accounting.
These static forests do not provide supercubic candidate-checking complexity.

title.zh: 仅对角邻接的网格森林：奇偶拆分与三次方界
title.en: Diagonal-only grid forests: parity decomposition and cubic bounds

summary.zh: 只允许四个对角方向时，两种奇偶类各自同构于四邻接网格，保留原检查次数上界与三次方最坏量级；补树障碍也可迁移。
summary.en: With diagonal directions only, each parity class is isomorphic to an orthogonal grid, preserving the check bound, cubic worst-case order, and tree-extension obstructions.

assumptions: Roads on an n-by-n board induce a forest using exactly the four diagonal directions (+/-1,+/-1); every such edge is retained.
Moves use the same four diagonal directions, without orthogonal moves, side-cell corner-cutting restrictions, or junctions at geometric edge crossings.
A start must execute the entire movement prefix. The candidate-list algorithm eliminates failures permanently and scans only at new relative displacements.
conclusions: The two parity classes separately reduce to orthogonal induced forests on boards of side at most n; answers and candidate checks add exactly.
W <= (5n-3)N; time O(n^2 + m + nN), hence O(n^3 + m); space O(n^2).
For m >= n-1, this candidate-list algorithm has matching worst-case time Theta(n^3 + m). Short walks admit O(n^2 + m + N min(m,n)).
Vertices from different parity classes can never be connected, even by adding vertices on arbitrarily enlarged boards.
Within one parity class, orthogonal tree-extension obstructions transfer, including Theta(n) components of size Theta(n) with pairwise nonextendability.
limitations: This is a corollary of the orthogonal cubic and obstruction proofs through lattice isomorphisms, not a new charging argument.
The reduction does not cover eight-neighbor movement or additional corner-cutting restrictions.
The lower bound concerns the candidate-list algorithm, not all possible algorithms. Finite verification supplements the general proof.
The original problem statement, direction encoding, and C++ reference program remain orthogonal.

title.zh: 线性轮筛选后仍有平方候选的单棵梳形树
title.en: A single comb tree retaining quadratically many candidates after linearly many scans

assumptions: n denotes board side length; effective scans visit previously unseen relative displacements.
conclusions: A single induced comb tree can retain Theta(n^2) candidates after Theta(n) effective scans.
limitations: The construction does not give supercubic total candidate checks; candidate count alone does not bound the full scan history.

title.zh: 方向 A 的连通资源并集不交猜想已被否定
title.en: Direction A's connected-resource-union disjointness conjecture is false

results.conjecture: After removing a reference class, each connected union U of remaining early-prefix resources satisfies U intersect (U+h) = empty for its horizontal label h.
conclusions: Opposite early arms give a counterexample. A connected union of individually short resources need not be short or disjoint from its label translate.
limitations: The source also contains a historical capacity-two draft with narrower assumptions. Use the current cubic proof for the final all-powers theorem.

title.zh: 较早的带对数因子复杂度上界
title.en: The earlier upper bound with a logarithmic factor

assumptions: The same induced-grid-forest candidate-list model as the current cubic bound.
conclusions: The bound O(n^3 log(n+1) + m) remains valid, but is weaker than the current O(n^3 + m) result.

title.zh: 方向 A 的早期有限验证记录
title.en: Early finite checks of direction A

conclusions: The tested cases did not refute direction A; the later opposite-early-arms construction refutes its general form.
limitations: A successful finite experiment does not establish the general disjointness conjecture or the cubic theorem.
